title: A tiny world model running games on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W
hook_text: Play games inside a tiny microcontroller
script:
Software developer Sebastien built a tiny world model running games on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W.
The open-source project is called tinyworldformer and uses a compact neural network.
It runs entirely on hardware with just five hundred twenty kilobytes of SRAM.
The microcontroller processes real-time visual predictions locally without any cloud connection.
This brings interactive neural simulations to extremely low-power edge devices.
Would you flash this model onto your microcontroller?
